transcript:
Header:
Date: 2027-02-18 10:00 PST
Duration: 72 minutes
Attendees: Celia (CEO), Ravi (CTO), Aisha (VP Product), Marcus (Head Eng), Sofia (Finance), Jun (People), plus all company on stream

Summary (auto): Leadership review, decisions on hiring pause, roadmap tighting, reliability incident update, next steps assigned.

[00:00] Celia: Hey everyone, thanks for joining on short notice, um we wanted to give a status update and make a few calls today. I'll keep this tight, a lot of concrete owners after.
[00:28] Ravi: Quick context from infra — last week we saw a cascading fallback in eu-west where the smart routing jumped to lower tier models during a spike and that triggered higher latency across Dedicated customers. It's on record, we have metrics and we've got a mitigation in place but we need a small program to prevent recurrence.
[00:52] Marcus: Right, it was a combination of autoscaler thresholds and the kernel selection path; some models were shifted to quantized variants incorrectly under our policy. I think there's a KV cache warmup problem too, uh the K V cache didn't populate as expected.
[01:14] Aisha: And product impact — a couple of demo customers saw degraded output quality; we had a support backlog. Not catastrophic but enough to force us to reprioritize reliability work over a couple of product experiments.
[01:34] Celia: So recommendation from leadership — tighten to top bets and institute a hiring pause for most IC roles for the next 60 days. Exceptions for revenue-critical roles or safety/compliance work. Jun will publish the exception flow.
[02:00] Jun: Yup, we'll put together a manager-facing FAQ and a templated form for exceptions. We'll also coordinate with People Partners to ensure any offers in flight are tracked.
[02:18] Sofia: Why the pause? the runway scenario analysis showed we have choices but the prudent path is to reduce burn to protect runway while we double down on high ROI bets. I'll share the set of scenarios after the call.
[02:40] Celia: I know this is heavy — the point is not to stop progress but to be deliberate. We're focusing energy on: 1) reliability & SLOs 2) Dedicated/Private performance parity 3) a small number of product bets that unlock >2x revenue or cost savings.
[03:10] Someone (Q): "What's the customer comms plan?"
[03:18] Aisha: We'll coordinate with sales — early heads up to top 20 accounts, targeted notes for Dedicated customers describing mitigation and roadmap items. We don't want broad alarm.
[03:35] Marcus: On the technical side, action items — immediate RCA, patch autocalc thresholds, add a routing canary to prevent wholesale model variant shifts. We'll also add better KV cache instrumentation.
[04:02] Ravi: Also testing matrix — we need to run controlled benches: Dedicated vs Hosted cost/latency at 1k and 4k context, quantized vs full-float for our top 3 family models. Marcus will lead that run, with product defining the scenarios.
[04:30] Celia: There's also a small governance ask: we will require any new experiment that costs more than X to get a two-sponsor signoff from Product + Finance because we need to be intentional about burn. Sofia will set the threshold.
[04:55] Sofia: I'll propose thresholds after pulling the spend data by org. Also we'll present runway to the board next month with these scenarios.
[05:10] Jun: People note — we'll freeze most requisitions, pause external agency spend for hiring, and prioritize critical, customer-impact roles. We'll also expedite transfers for internal candidates where possible.
[05:30] Celia: Questions?
[05:34] [06:00] Eng question (unlabeled): "Will this affect our Dedicated capacity commit roadmap?"
[06:10] Marcus: Short answer — no immediate change to committed Dedicated capacity, but we will slow new fleet expansions until we validate scaling and latency. If we can get caching and batch improvements we may avoid added spend.
[06:30] [07:02] Sales question: "Do we notify dedicated customers about a hiring pause?"
[07:10] Aisha: Not necessary for general customer base; we will brief strategic accounts if they ask or if their SLAs could be affected.
[07:30] Celia: On the roadmap, Aisha please present the top three bets — why these and why now.
[07:40] Aisha: Bet one: Improve latency and unit-cost via smarter batching + prefix caching — early modeling shows 20-40% token cost reduction for typical web workloads. Bet two: Parity work for Dedicated vs Hosted so that customers can pick deployment without a hit. Bet three: Expand Optimize tooling to auto-suggest quantization/profile settings per workload.
[08:20] Marcus: For bet two we need infra work: kernel selection telemetry, quantization safety checks, and a canary rollout path for model variants. This ties back to the incident.
[08:40] Ravi: Also a heads up, compliance and SOC-2 recert are due later this year; Private deployments need specific audit logs. That's a separate stream but we can't deprioritize it. We'll keep those teams staffed.
[09:05] Celia: We also talked briefly about go-to-market: sales and marketing will focus on proof points — cost/latency benchmarks and a few public case studies. Not everything, but the right ones.
[09:30] Q: Someone asks about restructuring?
[09:35] Celia: No broad restructure today. This is focus and tightening. If we need larger changes we'll surface them with full clarity.
[09:50] [10:10] Short cross talk, laughter, some people saying thanks
[10:30] Celia: Let's close with owners and dates — we'll publish a short note to the company after this call with clear FAQs and the action list.
[10:45] Ravi: I'll send the tech RCA draft and mitigation steps by Feb 21.
[10:52] Sofia: Finance will send scenario decks by Feb 23.
[11:00] Jun: People will send hiring pause FAQ and exceptions by Feb 20.
[11:10] Aisha: PMs will reconvene Friday to cut the roadmap to top three bets and remove lower impact work.
[11:30] Celia: Thank you all. Quick pulse check — we're doing the right thing; be candid with your teams and lean on managers.
[11:45] End of call.
